messages:
marta: posted updated compare-table mock in figma — added collapsible rows to group model variants. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-catalog (see frames V2-V4)

devon: nice. what's the intended affordance for collapse? chevron left/right or a separate toggle? we should keep keyboard affordance in mind.

marta: thinking chevron + row click opens details. collapsed state shows baseline metrics and a small badge list. expanded shows per-version metrics + commit/tag. quick prototype attached.

andy: small nit on copy for the collapsed summary: currently reads "Perf snapshot" — can we make it clearer for non-ML folks? e.g., "Recent performance (p95)" or "p95 latency — last 24h" ?

sam: prefer explicit: "p95 latency (24h)" — always include metric + window. otherwise folks assume median.

priya: accessibility note: chevron alone isn't enough for screen readers. we should add aria-expanded and an offscreen label like "Show details for model X". also ensure the entire row isn't a single button (that breaks keyboard focus for links inside).

a11y-bot: automated check: suggest adding role="button" with tabindex="0" and aria-controls linking to the details region. Use aria-expanded="false|true" toggled on activation. Also ensure collapse region has aria-hidden toggled.

devon: good call. implementation question: if expanded content contains interactive elements (copy version, pin button), do we keep them tabbable only when expanded? that's low-level but important for screen-reader flow.

andy: yes — hide via inert or aria-hidden and remove from tab order when collapsed. we already do this for rollout panels elsewhere.

marta: copy tweaks: current badge text uses short labels like "Fast"/"Accurate". suggestion: switch to numeric or percentile badges and a tooltip: e.g., "Latency: p95 120ms" and in tooltip "p95 over last 24h" — thoughts?

sam: numeric is better for engineers. Keep the semantic badge (color) + explicit number. color alone is ambiguous.

priya: color contrast: ensure badges meet AA. dark-green on light-green backgrounds often fails. we should run token colors through the contrast tool before finalizing.

devon: UX question: when user pins a version from expanded view, do we collapse other models or keep context? my vote: keep expanded so they can pin multiple quickly, but add a brief toast: "Pinned v2.3 for comparison" with an undo.

marta: agreed. also thinking about a global "pinned set" header in the compare rail so users see their pinned versions across rows.

andy: sorting/filter chips interplay: if we collapse rows, filters like "show pinned only" should still work. need to confirm behavior when row is collapsed vs filtered out.

sam: edge-case: if a pinned version belongs to a row that's hidden by filter, we should surface a small "Pinned (hidden by filter)" indicator somewhere, or auto-promote pinned to top when filter applied.

priya: keyboard flows: propose these key bindings when focus is on row chevron: Enter toggles expand, Space toggles expand, Right Arrow opens details (if collapsed), Left Arrow closes (if expanded). Document in accessibility doc.

devon: performance: expanded rows may fetch live metrics. prefer lazy-load on expand to avoid initial API cost. show skeletons while loading.

marta: yep, lazy-load + keep cached for session. also add a small "last updated" timestamp in expanded details.

andy: copy for version-pin action: current CTA is "Pin" — maybe "Pin for compare" is clearer, since users sometimes confuse pin with deploy/pin-to-latest.

sam: +1 "Pin for compare". and tooltip: "Pins this version so it appears in the compare rail across catalog".

priya: accessibility microcopy: when a version is pinned, screen reader should announce "Version 2.3 pinned for comparison." and focus should remain where it was, unless the user asked to move.

marta: ok action items: (1) design: update mock with explicit metric labels and contrast-correct badge colors; (2) dev: implement aria-expanded + lazy-load on expand + cache; (3) content: change microcopy to "p95 latency (24h)" and button -> "Pin for compare"; (4) UX: add pinned set header and toast undo.

devon: i'll take dev; will prototype keyboard interactions and share a small PR with aria attributes.

andy: i'll update copy and the tooltip strings, send a quick doc.

priya: i'll run a quick a11y checklist after the new colors and keyboard behaviors are in PR.

marta: thanks all — aim to sync again after PR review. :thumbsup:

sam: minor follow-up: in collapsed state, limit visible badges to 3 and show "+N" overflow so rows don't get too tall on mobile.

marta: noted — we'll add responsive rules. thanks!
